description: This file implements RADIUS server handling within the hostapd project, including TLS event handling, user data management, configuration, and main server loop.

methods.name: radius_tls_event
methods.description: Handles TLS events such as certificate verification, alerts, and peer certificates during TLS handshake.

methods.name: radius_userdata_init
methods.description: Initializes radius_user_data structure, setting up kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with radius_user_data, including kvlist and AVL tree.

methods.name: radius_userdata_load
methods.description: Loads user data into radius_user_data from a blob attribute, parsing JSON structure.

methods.name: load_userfile
methods.description: Loads user data from a specified file, updating user phase data if file modification time has changed.

methods.name: radius_user_get
methods.description: Retrieves user attribute blob by username, supporting wildcard pattern matching.

methods.name: radius_parse_attr
methods.description: Parses a radius attribute blob into structured data including vendor, type, format, and data.

methods.name: radius_count_attrs
methods.description: Counts total attributes and size needed for radius attributes based on user data blobs.

methods.name: radius_add_attr
methods.description: Adds a radius attribute to the radius attribute list, handling vendor-specific attributes.

methods.name: radius_parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses radius attributes from blob data and adds them to the attribute list.

methods.name: radius_user_parse_methods
methods.description: Parses EAP methods from blob data and updates the eap_user structure.

methods.name: radius_user_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a user state object for a given username, parsing user attributes.

methods.name: radius_get_eap_user
methods.description: Callback to retrieve EAP user data for a given identity, supporting phase 1 and phase 2.

methods.name: radius_setup
methods.description: Initializes the radius server with TLS and EAP configurations.

methods.name: radius_init
methods.description: Initializes radius server state and user data structures.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the radius main program.

methods.name: radius_main
methods.description: Main entry point for the radius server application, parsing command-line options, initializing, and running event loop.
